John 19:1.en: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
John 19:1.es: Así que, entonces tomó Pilato a Jesús, y le azotó.

John 19:2.en: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
John 19:2.es: Y los soldados entretejieron de espinas una corona, y pusiéronla sobre su cabeza, y le vistieron de una ropa de grana;

Matthew 27:30.en: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
Matthew 27:30.es: Y escupiendo en él, tomaron la caña, y le herían en la cabeza.

John 19:17.en: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
John 19:17.es: Y llevando su cruz, salió al lugar que se dice de la Calavera, y en hebreo, Gólgotha;

John 19:18.en: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
John 19:18.es: Donde le crucificaron, y con él otros dos, uno a cada lado, y Jesús en medio.

John 20:25.en: Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.
John 20:25.es: Si no viere en sus manos la señal de los clavos, y metiere mi dedo en el lugar de los clavos, y metiere mi mano en su costado, no creeré.

Luke 24:39.en: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.
Luke 24:39.es: Mirad mis manos y mis pies, que yo mismo soy: palpad, y ved; que el espíritu ni tiene carne ni huesos, como veis que yo tengo.

John 19:30.en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished.” Then he bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
John 19:30.es: Y como Jesús tomó el vinagre, dijo: Consumado es. Y habiendo inclinado la cabeza, dio el espíritu.

John 19:33.en: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
John 19:33.es: Mas cuando vinieron a Jesús, como le vieron ya muerto, no le quebraron las piernas:

John 19:34.en: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
John 19:34.es: Empero uno de los soldados le abrió el costado con una lanza, y luego salió sangre y agua.

Mark 15:46.en: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
Mark 15:46.es: El cual compró una sábana, y quitándole, le envolvió en la sábana: y le puso en un sepulcro que estaba cavado en una peña; y revolvió una piedra a la puerta del sepulcro.
